exposure.needed: which TLS trust bundles supplied to cert-manager exceed the previous PEM parse amount of pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes (the evidence states no size threshold and does not say where the bundles are configured)

consequence.statement: TLS trust bundles larger than the previous parse amount, which could not be read before, become readable by pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes after the upgrade; the evidence states no failure mode.
consequence.remediation: No action required; verify that large TLS trust bundles now parse as expected.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 increases the amount of PEM data that pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes can parse, enabling reading larger TLS trust bundles that previously could not be parsed.
